title: The refunds page says AI credits for a failed task come back automatically, but they are asked back only once and can be lost
what: The refunds page promises that if an AI task fails after its credits are taken, the same credits come back automatically. The admin app asks for them back once, straight after the failure. If that one ask fails (often the same lost internet that made the task fail), nothing tries again, and after 10 minutes the server refuses any give-back. The owner silently loses the credits.
expected: Credits for a failed task always come back, even when the internet drops at that moment, or the page does not promise it.
how_often: sometimes, when a task fails with a bad connection
fix_line: Retry the give-back later, or let the server give it back itself when a task is marked failed

title: The About page says free credits end at the end of each month, but the 20 starter credits never end
what: The About page lists 20 free credits for the free trial, then says free credits end on the last day of each month. The server never takes the 20 starter credits back: only the monthly free credits of yearly and founding gyms run out. An owner reading the page may rush to use credits that in fact stay.
expected: The page says the 20 starter credits stay until used, or the server ends them the way the page says.
how_often: every reader of the About page
fix_line: Say on the page that the 20 starter credits do not end at month end

title: After a test-mode payment the join page just says Paid with the amount, with no word that no real money moved
what: While the gym's online payments are in test mode, the join page shows a test-mode note before paying. Once the test payment goes through, the page says Paid and the amount and that the gym will approve the request, and the test-mode note is no longer shown.
expected: The paid line also says it was a test payment and no real money moved.
who: gym owners trying payments, and anyone who joins while the gym tests
how_often: every test payment on the join page
fix_line: Keep the test-mode note under the paid line

title: The gym's web page rounds plan prices to whole rupees, while the join page charges the exact price
what: The admin app lets a gym set a plan price with paise, such as 1,499.50. The gym's own web page rounds every price and joining fee to whole rupees, so it shows 1,500. The join page reached from the same button shows and charges 1,499.50.
expected: Both pages show the same amount the member will pay.
who: people looking at a gym's web page
fix_line: Show paise on the gym page the same way as on the join page

items.reason: Website prices (Starter 999/9,990, Pro 1,499/14,990, founding 29,999 first 25 until 31 Mar 2027, packs 149/399/999, no GST) match the server's price lists. Faults: extra branch half price is not charged (reused FN-L5-panel-pay-machines-02); 20 starter credits vs monthly plan none (reused FN-L5-panel-assistant-04); move-up costs more than the difference promised on the refunds page, promise P-A7-legal-2-86 (reused FN-L5-server-database-3-03); trial can be cut below 3 months, promise P-A7-legal-2-74 (reused FN-L5-server-database-1-02); overpay refund promise P-A7-legal-2-80 and P-A7-legal-3-19 has no record (reused FN-L5-panel-screens-2-02 and FN-L5-server-database-2-01, which also covers P-A7-legal-2-91); member questions also use credits (reused FN-A3-website-1-03); founding box says when the AI Assistant comes (reused FN-A3-website-1-06); new: failed-task credits may not come back, starter credits expiry wording.

The join page shows a test-mode note before paying (from the payment row's mode; UPI-only is always real money); after a test payment it says Paid with no test word (new FN-L5-web-pages-03). Test payments announced as real elsewhere: reused FN-L5-server-database-3-04. Pay online on the join page is switched off today (JOIN_PAY off).

Join page: failed shows try again or pay at desk, but promises money comes back with no step that sends it (reused FN-A3-website-2-06); open with UPI said shows the gym will check; expired or cancelled both say the page ran out of time, pay at the desk. Refunds page grace 7 days then 30 days basic mode matches the server's 7 and 37 days. A refund paid back cannot be recorded (reused FN-L5-server-database-2-01). The invite page always says pay at the desk (reused FN-A5-web-pages-1-01).

Join page amounts come from the gym server's price (totalP) and the payment is made for that same amount; the gym page uses the same plan prices but rounds to whole rupees (new FN-L5-web-pages-04). HQ shows half price for an extra branch while the server charges full (reused FN-L5-panel-pay-machines-02). The shared price list matches the website.
